topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder has read that GEO works but cannot picture what a concrete content change looks like, which edits have evidence behind them, and how to test one without fooling themselves.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity name a brand; this page turns GEO research and engine documentation into seven concrete rewrites and a repeat-run test protocol, backed by our crawler access study and recommendation benchmark with their caveats.

assessment: The page shows seven labelled, illustrative before-and-after rewrites (fictional Northwind Invoicing; Pew figures are the only real data in the boxes) and states for each what evidence exists: the GEO paper's results on its GPT-3.5 engine and Perplexity.ai, Google's July 2026 generative AI guide and documentation changelog, a recency-bias reranking study and SparkToro's repeat-run test. It also gives an access-first and one-pattern-at-a-time workflow and a repeat-run test protocol. It deliberately does not claim any rewrite earned a citation, compare engines, or say tables or FAQ markup are proven to help AI answers.

sources.supports: Aggarwal et al. GEO paper (KDD 2024): GEO-bench of 10,000 queries; Cite Sources, Quotation Addition and Statistics Addition gave 30-40% relative improvement on Position-Adjusted Word Count; fluency and easy-to-understand edits 15-30%; keyword stuffing little or no improvement and below baseline on Perplexity.ai; Cite Sources +115.1% for rank-5 and -30.3% for rank-1 sources; GPT-3.5-turbo engine fed top-5 Google results; term GEO introduced.

Google guide (last updated 2026-07-10): no need to write in a specific way just for generative AI search, no requirement to chunk content, no special schema.org markup needed, unique point of view and non-commodity content matter.
Documentation changelog: FAQ rich result no longer appears in Google Search starting May 7, 2026, documentation later removed.
Add a user-visible date, use datePublished/dateModified, keep visible and structured dates consistent, dates must describe the page's publication or update.

Recency-bias study: artificial publication dates on TREC passages shifted seven LLM rerankers' top-10 mean publication year forward by up to 4.78 years and moved items by up to 95 ranks; larger models attenuate but do not eliminate the effect.

600 volunteers, 2,961 runs (Nov-Dec 2025) on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI; under 1 in 100 chance of the same brand list, under 1 in 1,000 for the same order; author disclosed a conflict of interest with an AI-tracking vendor (Gumshoe.ai).
900 U.S. adults, March 2025 browsing data: traditional result clicked in 8% of visits with a Google AI summary vs 15% without.
Organization structured data on the home page can help Google understand the organization and disambiguate it in search results.
sameAs is the URL of a reference web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.
Entity linking is the task of assigning a unique identity to entities mentioned in text.
Sites opted out of OAI-SearchBot are not shown in ChatGPT search answers; GPTBot and OAI-SearchBot settings are independent.
To appear as a supporting link in AI Overviews or AI Mode a page must be indexed and snippet-eligible; no additional technical requirements.
